Now one of the really cool things about this place was that they used to fry their own omelettes, with anything you wanted in them. My mum is really into her health, and she brought us up to appreciate fruit and veg and so on, so we were pretty stoked that they had pretty much every vegetable you could imagine. Also, there were enormous amounts left, probably due to the fact that the average customer doesn't look much beyond the 4 types of cheese and obligatory 5 meats that they would order, or the multiplicity of other sweet and calorie-dense breakfast foods (no food shaming, eat whatever the shit you like so long as you don't become a pork beast).

Then, out of fucking nowhere or maybe everywhereteehee and at great speed, came what seemed to my 9-year-old mind to be an impossibly large butterhuffer. I can't have been more than 2 metres away from then when it hit me, so it must have known I was going for them. We were given free breakfast for the rest of our stay in Florida, and I don't blame the restaurant one bit, but that hambeast instilled in me (and my mother, who is like a goddamned tigress with her kids) a deep loathing of fats. The worst thing was, though, that we didn't even get a Danish, because those were the last ones for the next 30 minutes, and we wanted to go and do things instead of sitting in the restaurant all day.

TL;DR: King of the Buffet successfully ran down a child to claim 12 Danishes for himself, totally ignoring the injury it caused and ruining the one time I was allowed cake at breakfast.
